manager_meta_title: SotF Mods Manager: install Sons of the Forest mods with one click
manager_meta_description: Free Windows app that installs mods from SOTF Mods with their libraries and RedLoader, keeps them updated and switches between mod profiles.
manager_title: Install Sons of the Forest mods with one click
manager_lead: SotF Mods Manager is a free Windows app for the mods on this site. It installs RedLoader, downloads each mod with the libraries it needs and tells you when there is an update.
manager_shot_main: SotF Mods Manager listing the mods of SOTF Mods, with Axel's Mod Menu selected
manager_hand_1: Download RedLoader from GitHub and extract it into the game folder.
manager_hand_2: Download the mod as a zip file.
manager_hand_3: Read its page to find the libraries it needs, and download each one.
manager_hand_4: Extract everything into the Mods folder.
manager_hand_5: Check the site now and then, and repeat all of it for every update.
manager_app_text: If RedLoader is missing, the manager installs it first. Then it downloads the mod and its libraries into the right folders, and warns you if the mod clashes with one you already have.
manager_shot_install: The install dialog: a mod that needs another one and does not work with a mod already installed
manager_app_links: Mod and build pages on this site have an Install with launcher button that opens the manager on that mod.
manager_updates_text: The Installed and Updates tabs show what you have. A mod with a new version gets an Update button.
manager_profiles_text: Keep one set of mods for solo and another for multiplayer, and switch between them without downloading anything again. Modpacks from this site open as a new profile.
manager_redloader_text: Install, repair, update or remove RedLoader from the settings. You can pin a version and undo the last change.
manager_crash_text: When the game crashes, the manager comes to the front and offers the RedLoader and game logs, so you can find the mod that caused it.
manager_shot_installed: The Installed tab with the mods that have updates
manager_shot_import: Importing a shared profile as a new profile
manager_shot_settings: The settings with the RedLoader options
manager_shot_crash: The crash dialog offering the logs
manager_faq_safe_a: Mods come only from SOTF Mods and RedLoader only from its official GitHub releases. The exe is not signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time: click More info, then Run anyway. The source code is public.
manager_faq_manual_q: What happens to mods I installed by hand?
manager_faq_manual_a: They show up in the Installed tab as Manual. The manager does not update or remove them.
manager_faq_slow_q: Why is the first start with mods slow?
manager_faq_slow_a: Microsoft Defender scans every RedLoader file the first time. The Defender exclusion option in the settings skips that scan.
manager_faq_cost_a: No. It is free and open source under the MIT license.
